dialogue.content: こんにちは。本日はよろしくお願いいたします。
dialogue.English: Hello. Thank you for coming in today.

dialogue.content: こちらこそ、よろしくお願いします
dialogue.English: Thank you for having me.

dialogue.content: 少し早いですが、始めますか？
dialogue.English: It's a little early, but shall we get started?

dialogue.content: 大丈夫ですお任せします
dialogue.English: That's fine. I'll leave it up to you.

dialogue.content: では始めます。
dialogue.English: Alright, let's begin.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: こんにちは。相談員です。本日はどのようなご相談でしょうか。
dialogue.English: Hello. I'm a counselor. How can I help you today?

dialogue.content: 学校に行くのがつらいんです
dialogue.English: It's really hard for me to go to school.

dialogue.content: 学校に行くのがつらいのですね。今あなたは何年生ですか？
dialogue.English: I see, so it's hard for you to go to school. What grade are you in now?

dialogue.content: 高1です
dialogue.English: I'm a first-year in high school.

dialogue.content: 高校生ですか^^中学から環境ががらっと変わったタイミングだから、色々大変ですよね。
dialogue.English: A high school student, I see. It's a time when your environment changes completely from junior high, so I imagine things must be tough.

dialogue.content: はい...
dialogue.English: Yes...

dialogue.content: 良かったらお名前を教えていただいてもよろしいですか？(ニックネームでも可)
dialogue.English: If you don’t mind, could you tell me your name? (A nickname is fine, too.)

dialogue.content: ひろ、です
dialogue.English: It's Hiro.

dialogue.content: ひろさんですね。いいお名前ですね^^
dialogue.English: Hiro, I see. That's a nice name. ^^

dialogue.content: そうかな
dialogue.English: You think so?

dialogue.content: ひろさんは学校で何がつらいのですか？
dialogue.English: Hiro, what is it about school that's difficult for you?

dialogue.content: 普通にできません
dialogue.English: I can't do things normally.

dialogue.content: 普通にできないですか。。。他の人と同じように出来ないと言った感じでしょうか？
dialogue.English: You can't do things normally... Does it feel like you can't do things the same way as everyone else?

dialogue.content: 学校に行く前から毎朝、つらいです
dialogue.English: Every morning, even before I go to school, I feel awful.

dialogue.content: 毎朝つらいのですね。毎日のことでは苦しいですよね。
dialogue.English: So it's painful every morning. That must be agonizing to go through every day.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: 普通に出来ないというのは、どう言ったことから感じるのですか？
dialogue.English: What makes you feel that you can’t do things “normally”?

dialogue.content: 朝、鏡に向かって、スカートをはくのが、しんどくて…
dialogue.English: In the morning, looking in the mirror and putting on a skirt is so exhausting...

dialogue.content: はきたくない
dialogue.English: I don't want to wear it.

dialogue.content: スカートを履くのが…本当はどんな格好をしたいのですか？
dialogue.English: Wearing a skirt... What kind of clothes would you actually like to wear?

dialogue.content: スラックスがはきたい
dialogue.English: I want to wear slacks.

dialogue.content: そうなのですね。では男子生徒のような格好が良いということですか？
dialogue.English: I see. So you'd prefer to dress like the male students?

dialogue.content: はい、おかしいですよね
dialogue.English: Yes... that's weird, isn't it?

dialogue.content: そんなことないと思いますよ^^好きは人それぞれです。
dialogue.English: I don't think it's weird at all. ^^ Everyone has their own preferences.

dialogue.content: 失礼ですが、ひろさんの身体は女性なのですか？
dialogue.English: Forgive me for asking, but is your physical body female?

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: 心はどちらなのでしょうか？答えにくければ答えなくても良いですよ。
dialogue.English: And which do you feel you are in your heart? You don't have to answer if you're not comfortable.

dialogue.content: スカート履くのは、耐えられない、苦痛なんです。おかしいですよね？
dialogue.English: Wearing a skirt is unbearable, it's agonizing. That's weird, right?

dialogue.content: 少なくとも私はおかしいと思いません。
dialogue.English: At the very least, I don’t think it’s weird.

dialogue.content: 支えになるかわかりませんが、
dialogue.English: I'm not sure if this will help, but...

dialogue.content: 自分の姿が気持ち悪いです
dialogue.English: I feel disgusted by how I look.

dialogue.content: 私は身体が男性ですが、心は女性です。なのでズボンを履きたくないです。
dialogue.English: My body is male, but my heart is female. So I don't want to wear pants.

dialogue.content: ひろさんとは逆と言った感じでしょうか。
dialogue.English: It's kind of the opposite of you, Hiro.

dialogue.content: なので気持ちはとても分かります。
dialogue.English: So, I can really understand how you feel.

dialogue.content: 私も自分の姿が嫌いです。
dialogue.English: I also hate my own appearance.

dialogue.content: たがらそれをおかしいと思う必要はないですよ。
dialogue.English: So you don't need to think that it's weird.

dialogue.content: 本当ですか！？
dialogue.English: Really!?

dialogue.content: ええ^^
dialogue.English: Yes. ^^

dialogue.content: でも、
dialogue.English: But...

dialogue.content: はい。
dialogue.English: Yes?

dialogue.content: 実際、トイレに行くのは本当に違和感があって、苦しいんです
dialogue.English: In reality, going to the restroom feels really wrong, and it's agonizing.

dialogue.content: 相談員さんは、どうしてるんですか？
dialogue.English: What do you do, counselor?

dialogue.content: それは女子トイレに入るのに違和感を感じるということですか？私は身体が男性なので、男性用のトイレを使用しています。
dialogue.English: Does that mean you feel a sense of wrongness when you enter the girls' restroom? Since my body is male, I use the men's restroom.

dialogue.content: でも私も男性用トイレ使うのは本当は嫌です。
dialogue.English: But I actually hate using the men's restroom too.

dialogue.content: なので必ず個室に入るようにして気持ちを誤魔化してます
dialogue.English: So I always make sure to go into a stall to trick my feelings.

dialogue.content: 私は、できれば行きたくないけど
dialogue.English: I'd rather not go if I can help it, but...

dialogue.content: ええ
dialogue.English: I understand.

dialogue.content: 我慢も限界あるから、もう、学校にも行きたくない
dialogue.English: There's a limit to how much I can hold it in, so I just don't want to go to school anymore.

dialogue.content: トイレは生理現象ですもの。そう思うのはおかしくありません。
dialogue.English: Using the restroom is a biological necessity. It's not strange to feel that way.

dialogue.content: 服装とトイレそれらが原因で学校が嫌なのですね。
dialogue.English: So clothing and the restroom are the reasons school feels unbearable.

dialogue.content: 更衣室も、地獄
dialogue.English: The changing room is hell, too.

dialogue.content: そうですよね。。。更衣室も苦しいですよね。この悩みは誰かに相談したりしましたか？
dialogue.English: I can imagine... the changing room must be hard as well. Have you talked to anyone about this?

dialogue.content: 言えるわけありません
dialogue.English: There’s no way I could tell anyone.

dialogue.content: そうなのですね。なぜ言えないと思うのでしょうか。
dialogue.English: I see. What makes you feel you can’t tell anyone?

dialogue.content: こんなこと知れたら、みんな気持ち悪がる。
dialogue.English: If people knew this about me, everyone would be disgusted.

dialogue.content: 気持ち悪がられると思うから言えないのですね。。。
dialogue.English: So you can't tell anyone because you think they'll be disgusted...

dialogue.content: そう思うと言うことも辛いですよね。
dialogue.English: It must be painful to even think that.

dialogue.content: てか、知られたくない
dialogue.English: I mean, I don’t want anyone to know.

dialogue.content: 知られたくないと思うのですか？
dialogue.English: You don't want anyone to know?

dialogue.content: バレたら、考えると、恐怖です
dialogue.English: The thought of being found out... it's terrifying.

dialogue.content: 耐えられない…
dialogue.English: I couldn't bear it...

dialogue.content: 知られて、気持ち悪がられる未来。それがひろさんには見えるのですね。。。
dialogue.English: A future where people find out and are disgusted. You can see that happening, can't you, Hiro?

dialogue.content: だって、何をするにも、自分のこと自覚しなきやならなくて
dialogue.English: Because whatever I do, I have to be aware of myself—

dialogue.content: ええ
dialogue.English: I see.

dialogue.content: 今までこんなヤツに会ったことないし、みんな異常だって思うに決まってる
dialogue.English: I've never met anyone like this before, and everyone is bound to think I'm abnormal.

dialogue.content: 異常だと感じるのですね。。。でも少なくとも私も似たような境遇ですよ^^
dialogue.English: You feel that you're abnormal... But at least I'm in a similar situation, too. ^^

dialogue.content: だからそう感じているのはこの世にあなた1人ではありません。
dialogue.English: So, you're not the only one in the world who feels this way.

dialogue.content: 味方や理解者は少なからず存在しますよ。、
dialogue.English: There are allies and people who understand, even if not many.

dialogue.content: 相談員さんは、いじめられなかったの？
dialogue.English: Weren't you bullied, counselor?

dialogue.content: いじめはありませんでしたが、
dialogue.English: I wasn't bullied, but...

dialogue.content: 修学旅行などのお風呂は苦しかったです。
dialogue.English: The public baths on things like school trips were very difficult.

dialogue.content: そうですよね
dialogue.English: I can imagine.

dialogue.content: なので先生に言って個室の浴室を使う許可を得ました。
dialogue.English: So I told a teacher and got permission to use a private bathing room.

dialogue.content: よく言えましたね⁈
dialogue.English: You were able to say that?!

dialogue.content: 苦痛に耐えるのもバレて何かある苦しみもどっちも耐えられなかったので、
dialogue.English: I couldn't bear the pain of enduring it, nor the suffering of something happening if I was found out,

dialogue.content: だったらいっそ言ってしまえと思いました笑
dialogue.English: so I thought I might as well just say it. (laughs)

dialogue.content: もらややけくそでした。
dialogue.English: I was pretty much desperate.

dialogue.content: もはやですすみません。
dialogue.English: Sorry, I meant to say I was pretty much desperate.

dialogue.content: えー、すごいですね自分には真似できるとは、とても思えないです
dialogue.English: Wow, that's amazing. I really don't think I could ever do that.

dialogue.content: もちろん言うことが正しいとはいいません。
dialogue.English: Of course, I'm not saying that telling someone is the right thing to do.

dialogue.content: 言えない気持ちも分かりますもの。
dialogue.English: I also understand the feeling of not being able to say it.

dialogue.content: 先生がわかってくれるとは限らないし…
dialogue.English: There's no guarantee a teacher would understand...

dialogue.content: そうですよね。その保証はあるとはいえません。
dialogue.English: That's true. There’s no guarantee of that.

dialogue.content: 私はあなたの味方です。だからこそ適当なアドバイスをしてあなたを傷つけたくないので、一緒にちゃんと考えていきませんか^^？
dialogue.English: I am on your side. That's why I don't want to hurt you by giving you careless advice. So, why don't we think about this properly together? ^^

dialogue.content: 怖いけど、このままじゃ、どうにかなりそうです
dialogue.English: I'm scared, but if things stay like this, I feel like I'm going to lose it.

dialogue.content: どうしたらいいでしょう
dialogue.English: What should I do?

dialogue.content: そうですよね。。。ではどうなればその苦しさから解放されるでしょうか。
dialogue.English: I understand... Well then, what would it take for you to be freed from that suffering?

dialogue.content: 現実的な考えでなく、夢物語のような理想でもいいです。なにか思いつきますか？
dialogue.English: It doesn't have to be realistic; a dream-like ideal is fine, too. Does anything come to mind?

dialogue.content: 自分の自然を通すとバレるのは考えただけでも怖いしな…もう、魔法しかないのかな、ばかみたい。
dialogue.English: If I go with what feels natural to me, just thinking about being found out is scary... Maybe only magic could fix this. I sound stupid.

dialogue.content: その魔法はどんな魔法ですか？
dialogue.English: What kind of magic would that be?

dialogue.content: よかったら教えてください^^
dialogue.English: If you don't mind, please tell me. ^^

dialogue.content: タイムスリップして、何事も無かったように、オレは、男友達とツーリング
dialogue.English: To time-slip, and as if nothing had ever happened, I'd be touring on motorcycles with my guy friends.

dialogue.content: ええ
dialogue.English: I see.

dialogue.content: みんなの記憶から過去を消し去る、そんな映画あったかも。
dialogue.English: Erasing the past from everyone's memory... I think there was a movie like that.

dialogue.content: 面白そうな魔法(映画)ですね^^
dialogue.English: That sounds like an interesting magic (or movie). ^^

dialogue.content: では実際にその魔法使ってみてはいかがですか？
dialogue.English: Then why don't you try using that magic in reality?

dialogue.content: は？
dialogue.English: Huh?

dialogue.content: 男友達とツーリングいくという夢
dialogue.English: The dream of going on a tour with your male friends—

dialogue.content: 叶えるよう動いてみてはいかがでしょう
dialogue.English: how about taking steps to make it come true?

dialogue.content: えっ、バレるぜ
dialogue.English: What? They'd find out.

dialogue.content: そのツーリングする男友達にですか？
dialogue.English: By those guy friends you'd be touring with?

dialogue.content: それもそうだし、どういうこと？
dialogue.English: That, and... what do you mean?

dialogue.content: でもその友達と魔法の世界なら他の人間は居ないはず。
dialogue.English: But in that magical world with your friend, there shouldn't be anyone else.

dialogue.content: なので、
dialogue.English: So...

dialogue.content: 1人にだけたった1人でいいからひろさんの本当の姿を知ってもらうのはどうですか。
dialogue.English: How about letting just one person—only one person is enough—get to know the real you, Hiro?

dialogue.content: えー考えてみたこともなかった
dialogue.English: Wow, I've never even considered that.

dialogue.content: いきなり校内放送でバラすような大きいことは怖いですけど
dialogue.English: It would be scary to do something big like announcing it over the school PA system,

dialogue.content: たった1人ならどうですか？
dialogue.English: but what if it’s just one person?

dialogue.content: 現実のはなしとして、ですか？
dialogue.English: You mean, in real life?

dialogue.content: そうですね。現実として。そしてその人とツーリングいく未来を想像したら楽しそうじゃないですか？
dialogue.English: Yes, in real life. And if you imagine a future where you go on a tour with that person, doesn’t that sound fun?

dialogue.content: それが叶えば。
dialogue.English: If that could come true.

dialogue.content: 夢を見るのは楽しそうだけど…
dialogue.English: Dreaming about it sounds fun, but...

dialogue.content: 夢を先ず見て、その夢に向かって活動すれば気が紛れそうな気もします^^
dialogue.English: If you first allow yourself to dream and then take steps toward it, it might help take your mind off things. ^^

dialogue.content: 悩みというのは1人で抱え込むのはとてもつらいです。
dialogue.English: Holding onto worries all by yourself is very painful.

dialogue.content: たった1人でも理解者が近くにいると、安心感が違ってくると思うのですが。
dialogue.English: I think having just one person nearby who understands can make a huge difference in how secure you feel.

dialogue.content: うろたえる…オレが居るでもこのままじゃ壊れてしまうよな
dialogue.English: I'm panicking... a part of me is, anyway. But if I stay like this, I'm going to break down.

dialogue.content: 壊れてしまってはその魔法も使えないし、夢もかないませんよ。そのツーリング仲間に選べそうなお友達は身近にいますか？
dialogue.English: If you break down, you won't be able to use that magic or make your dream come true. Is there a friend nearby who you could choose as that touring companion?

dialogue.content: 居ることはいるけど、
dialogue.English: There is someone, but...

dialogue.content: 素敵ですね^^
dialogue.English: That's wonderful. ^^

dialogue.content: その先が…
dialogue.English: It's what comes after that...

dialogue.content: 今すぐカミングアウトしろとは言いません。ただ未来の可能性として、その人にだけでも言うことは出来そうですか？
dialogue.English: I'm not telling you to come out right now. But as a future possibility, does it seem like you could tell just that one person?

dialogue.content: 夢は見たいと思うけど、今の自分にはその勇気が足りてない気がする
dialogue.English: I want to have that dream, but I feel like I don't have enough courage for it right now.

dialogue.content: 勇気を持つことに繋がるか分かりませんが、私は友達にカミングアウトしたとき「何となくそんな気はしてたよ^^言ってくれてありがとう。どんな格好、考えを持っていようが、お前はお前だ。」と言われました。
dialogue.English: I don't know if this will help you find courage, but when I came out to my friend, they said, "I kind of had a feeling. ^^ Thanks for telling me. No matter what you wear or what you think, you're you."

dialogue.content: そんなセリフ、そのお友達が言ってくれる未来は想像できますか？
dialogue.English: Can you imagine a future where your friend says something like that to you?

dialogue.content: 夢の中だけだったら…
dialogue.English: Only in a dream...

dialogue.content: 今はそれでいいと思います。
dialogue.English: For now, I think that’s perfectly fine.

dialogue.content: その希望が持てるだけでも、明日を生きようと思えませんか？
dialogue.English: Just by having that hope, don't you think it makes you feel like you can face tomorrow?

dialogue.content: 気持ち、少し軽くなりました
dialogue.English: I feel a little lighter.

dialogue.content: それは良かったです。
dialogue.English: I’m glad to hear that.

dialogue.content: 今無理に何かをしようとせず、
dialogue.English: Don't try to force yourself to do anything right now.

dialogue.content: すこし妄想を楽しんでみてください^^こんなふうになったらいいなぁって。
dialogue.English: Just try to enjoy daydreaming a little. ^^ Thinking, "It would be nice if things turned out like this."

dialogue.content: 妄想か…
dialogue.English: Daydreaming, huh...

dialogue.content: そろそろお時間になってしまいます。学校が辛いという悩みをスパッと解決出来ませんでしたが、相談に来てみていかがでしたか？
dialogue.English: It's almost time for us to finish. We couldn't solve your problem with school being hard in one go, but how did you feel about coming in to talk today?

dialogue.content: 妄想ならできるかな、と今思ってますまたきっと、気持ちぐるぐるしそうだけど。
dialogue.English: I'm thinking now that maybe I can daydream. I'm sure my feelings will start swirling around again, though.

dialogue.content: 少しずつ、1歩ずつ。ちょっとずつ色々変えていきましょう。自分が潰れないように。
dialogue.English: Little by little, one step at a time. Let’s change things bit by bit, so you don’t get crushed.

dialogue.content: 潰れたくないです
dialogue.English: I don't want to be crushed.

dialogue.content: その気持ちがあればきっと大丈夫‼
dialogue.English: With that feeling, I’m sure you’ll be okay!

dialogue.content: とりあえず、明日は学校に足がむきそうです
dialogue.English: For now, I think I can bring myself to go to school tomorrow.

dialogue.content: それは良かった。
dialogue.English: That's great.

dialogue.content: 1日行けるだけでもえらいです‼
dialogue.English: It's amazing just to be able to go for one day!

dialogue.content: また苦しくなったり、勇気が持てなくなったら来てください^^私たち相談員はひろさんの味方ですよ^^
dialogue.English: If things get tough again, or if you feel like you're losing your courage, please come back. ^^ We counselors are on your side, Hiro. ^^

dialogue.content: ありがとうございます
dialogue.English: Thank you.

dialogue.content: そしたら、またお願いします
dialogue.English: If that happens, I'll be back.

dialogue.content: それでは本日はこれで失礼します。
dialogue.English: Well then, that's all for today.

dialogue.content: もちろんです^^
dialogue.English: Of course. ^^

dialogue.content: はい、ありがとうございました！
dialogue.English: Yes, thank you very much!

dialogue.content: ありがとうございました。
dialogue.English: Thank you.

dialogue.content: (ロールプレイありがとうございました。)
dialogue.English: (Thank you for the role-play.)

dialogue.content: 大変勉強になりました。お疲れ様でした
dialogue.English: It was a great learning experience. Thank you for your hard work.

dialogue.content: (こちらこそありがとうございました。それでは終了します。)
dialogue.English: (Thank you as well. This concludes the session.)
